description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2012 World Championships, drawing cards fast and speeding up Energy to power Darkrai-EX and Mewtwo-EX: Professor Oak's New Theory and N draw, Dark Patch adds Energy and Shaymin moves it around. The 2012 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa, Hawaii, from 10 to 12 August 2012.

Pokémon sold it as a 2012 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
